_metadata.om_reference: PLACEHOLDER — not yet verified against official OM
_metadata.notes: Values are estimates from publicly available Rotax 915iS specifications. MUST be verified against the official Operators Manual before use in a real aircraft. Do not rely on these limits for operational decisions.

_expected_hot_cylinder_note: Spec 08 §3: prior for the usual hottest cylinder until an aircraft's own is learned; a display hint, never a limit. Unverified placeholder.
_exceedance_merge_gap_s_note: Spec 09 §6.2: an exceedance event ends only after the reading has stayed within the limit this many seconds; shorter dips are absorbed into the event.
_cas_note: Spec 01 §8.6: ENGINE ECU run extraction. Runs separated by less than merge_gap_s are merged; runs shorter than min_event_duration_s after merging are not events (counted as sub-threshold blips — at 1 Hz a one-row CAS token is indistinguishable from a sampling artefact). Distinct from exceedance_merge_gap_s. Not OM values.

limits.label: Idle RPM minimum
limits._exceedance_merge_gap_s_note: Spec 09 Q3: no merging — min_duration_s 30 exists to ignore brief governor dips, and merging would join them into long events (54 → 100 events on the N117ZS log set at a 30 s gap).
limits._min_rpm_note: Checked only with the engine at or above 1,000 rpm, so a stopped engine (0 rpm before start or after shutdown) isn't an idle exceedance.
limits._requires_reached_since_start_note: Spec 10 D16: the idle minimum applies only after rpm has reached min_val at least once since engine start, so spool-up isn't an idle exceedance.

limits.label: Oil pressure min (>3500 rpm)
limits._filter_policy_note: Spec 09 Q1: the most direct sign of lubrication failure — never filterable.

filter_policy.reason: Low oil pressure at power is the most direct sign of a lubrication problem, so it is always reported. If you suspect the sender or gauge, have it checked rather than filtering the reading.

limits._min_rpm_note: Checked only with the engine at or above 1,000 rpm, same physics as volts_min/fuel_press_min/rpm_idle_min: with the engine stopped the oil pump isn't turning and the reading falls to 0 psi, which is not a fault.

limits.label: Manifold pressure maximum
limits.note: PLACEHOLDER — verify against OM. 915iS max boost approximately 1,600 hPa.

limits.label: Bus voltage minimum
limits._min_rpm_note: Checked only with the engine at or above 1,000 rpm, same gate as fuel_press_min and rpm_idle_min: with the engine stopped (master or avionics off at shutdown) the bus reads 0.0 V, which is not a fault.
